entry.title: Campfire Transmissions 2026-11-21
entry.summary: France 24 reported that three Russian projectiles came down in Poland on Friday, prompting NATO to condemn what it called a grave violation of Polish airspace. France 24 also reported a drone strike set a Russian cargo ship ablaze in the Gulf of Finland before it drifted into Finnish territorial waters, where Finnish authorities alerted NATO and imposed temporary restrictions; the outlet reported the Saudi-led coalition intercepted three ballistic missiles fired toward Riyadh early Saturday.
entry.content:
Top line: France 24 reported that three Russian projectiles came down in Poland on Friday, prompting NATO to condemn what it called a grave violation of Polish airspace. France 24 also reported a drone strike set a Russian cargo ship ablaze in the Gulf of Finland before it drifted into Finnish territorial waters, where Finnish authorities alerted NATO and imposed temporary restrictions; the outlet reported the Saudi-led coalition intercepted three ballistic missiles fired toward Riyadh early Saturday.

Europe / Russia

  • France 24 reported that three Russian projectiles came down in Poland on Friday and that NATO condemned what it called a grave violation of Polish airspace. (attributed) [1]
  • France 24 reported that a Russian cargo ship caught fire after a drone strike in international waters in the Gulf of Finland, then drifted into Finnish territorial waters; Finnish authorities alerted NATO and imposed temporary restrictions in the area. (attributed) [2]
  • BBC News World reported that Russia struck bridges and railway stations in Kyiv in a major attack. (attributed) [3]

Middle East

  • France 24 reported that the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired toward Riyadh early Saturday, marking the second Houthi attack on the Saudi capital in recent days. (attributed) [4]

Cyber and Infrastructure

  • The Record reported that researchers said a China-linked threat actor used the Cairn AI tool to persistently attack two universities and possibly discover a zero-day bug in one case. (attributed) [5]

Changes since previous brief

4 new and 1 updated development(s) reported.

  • Updated since previous brief: Aramco Tower hit in heart of Saudi capital as Houthis launch fresh strikes [4]

Watch items (next 24-72 hours)

  • Any extension or lifting of temporary restrictions in the Gulf of Finland. Would indicate whether the response to the ship incident is continuing or has ended. [2]
  • Further coalition-reported ballistic missile interceptions toward Riyadh. Would indicate additional missile launches toward the Saudi capital. [4]

Sources

  1. France 24: Russian projectiles hit Poland as NATO tensions rise
  2. France 24: Drone attack sets Russian cargo ship ablaze in Gulf of Finland
  3. BBC News World: What we know about the latest Russian missile strikes on Ukraine
  4. France 24: Houthis launch strikes on Saudi Arabia
  5. The Record: Amazon says Chinese hackers used Cairn AI tool to discover apparent zero-day during attack on university

entry.title: Campfire Transmissions 2026-11-20
entry.summary: BBC News World reported that three bridges in Kyiv were hit during a major Russian missile attack, killing five people. France 24 reported that Poland said no one was hurt after Warsaw alleged a Russian missile hit southeast Poland during an attack on Ukraine; BleepingComputer reported that Broadcom released updates for a VMware vCenter vulnerability exploited in attacks.
entry.content:
Top line: BBC News World reported that three bridges in Kyiv were hit during a major Russian missile attack, killing five people. France 24 reported that Poland said no one was hurt after Warsaw alleged a Russian missile hit southeast Poland during an attack on Ukraine; BleepingComputer reported that Broadcom released updates for a VMware vCenter vulnerability exploited in attacks.

Europe / Russia

  • BBC News World reported that three Kyiv bridges were hit during a major Russian missile attack, killing five people; it said the strikes followed Ukraine's targeting of the Crimean Bridge. The event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated. (attributed) [1]
  • France 24 reported that Poland said no one was hurt after Warsaw alleged a Russian missile hit southeast Poland during an attack on Ukraine. Polish authorities were investigating reports that at least two unknown objects had fallen near the border with Ukraine. The event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated. (attributed) [2]
  • BBC News World reported that Putin vowed a “far more painful” response to Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean Bridge, which suffered major damage following a combined attack by Ukraine earlier that week. The event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated. (attributed) [6]

Other Regions

  • Deutsche Welle reported that Sean Cairncross was leaving the national cyber director role after a week of tech outages and that Kirsten Davies would assume it in an acting capacity. BBC News World reported that CBS said Cairncross had been fired after losing the confidence of White House chief of staff Stephen Miller. The event time was not stated. (attributed) [4][5]

Cyber and Infrastructure

  • BleepingComputer reported that Broadcom released security updates for a critical VMware vCenter Server authentication bypass vulnerability that Chinese-linked hackers had exploited in zero-day attacks since September 2026. The update's event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated. (attributed) [3]

Significant Disasters

  • GDACS listed a magnitude 5.6 earthquake at a depth of 10 km southeast of the Loyalty Islands at 00:49 UTC on 20/11/2026. The report was not independently corroborated. (attributed) [7]

Changes since previous brief

5 new and 1 updated development(s) reported.

  • Updated since previous brief: Green earthquake (Magnitude 6.4M, Depth:10km) in Southeast Of Easter Island 29/10/2026 07:49 UTC, [unknown]. [7]

Watch items (next 24-72 hours)

  • Polish authorities' findings on the unknown objects near the Ukraine border Could clarify the reports of a possible missile impact in southeast Poland. [2]
  • Whether Broadcom's vCenter security updates are applied Would indicate remediation of the authentication bypass vulnerability reported as exploited in attacks. [3]

Sources

  2. France 24: Poland's Tusk denounces Russian 'provocation' after Warsaw says missile hit territory

entry.content:

entry.content:

France 24 reported US flights were resuming after a nationwide ground stop, with more than 2,000 cancellations as airlines worked to return to normal operations.
